shape_source.name: P1 11-omino (11P1)
shape_source.shape_description: 11 cells; bounding box 5 by 3; bottom row has five cells and the next two rows each have three left-aligned cells.
shape_source.orientations: The source SVG includes all eight D4 orientations, including rotations and reflections.

public_rectangle.credited_source: Michael Reid, 11omino7_rect.html; the polyominoes.org page attributes the 54x55 tiling to this page.
public_rectangle.secondary_archive_statement: 11-omino, order 270, 54 by 55; entry cites a 1997 construction from Karl Dahlke associated with B. A. Wichmann's World of Patterns (2001).
public_rectangle.reproduction_status: The SVG placements were decoded and independently checked cell by cell. They cover the 54x55 rectangle with 270 D4-congruent copies.

alternate_reported_rectangle.reproduction_status: Reported in the Reid source. Not decoded or independently reproduced. This weaker result does not change the 270-copy verified upper bound.

independent_seed_search.ai_provenance: A task agent wrote the search script and ran the CP-SAT search. This is a locally generated AI-assisted seed, not the published human construction.
independent_seed_search.method: CP-SAT exact cover with one Boolean variable per shape placement and an exactly-one constraint per rectangle cell
independent_seed_search.input_scope: The solver script encodes only the fixed 11P1 cells and rectangle dimensions. It does not read the human SVG or reference witness.

result.solver_status_note: The satisfaction model returned a feasible exact cover. This does not prove that 270 is the global minimum over all rectangles.

independent_seed_search.replay_note: The script has an 1800-second cap. Wall time and whether a feasible result is found can vary by machine; the saved witness is independently checked by check.py.

optimality_status.current_page_statement: The modern polyominoes.org source labels the order as <=270 and calls 54x55 the smallest known rectangle. It does not provide a lower-bound proof for the minimum number of tiles.
optimality_status.status: Open in checked sources through 2026-11-06. The 270 witness is an upper bound only; the page's <= label is not treated as a proof of minimum order.
